overview: This enum identifies which voice variant a customizable attack-voice pack provides.

None.technical: None is the constructor default for CharacterCustomVoice rows. CollectVoiceSamples precreates only the Default, TypeA, and TypeB buckets, so a None row is never added to preview samples. GUnknownByteIntMap0 maps it to saved integer 0, which restores the same voice-group-set slot as Default. No exported CharacterCustomVoice row uses None.

Default.technical: CollectVoiceSamples precreates the Default bucket and appends matching sample ids. The tile treats Default as unlocked without an owned voice item. The icon uses the category-specific Default color. GUnknownByteIntMap0 maps Default to saved integer 0, which selects Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet at index zero for normal or Cursed Energy attacks in battle.

TypeA.technical: CollectVoiceSamples precreates the TypeA bucket and appends matching sample ids. The tile requires an owned item whose VariableId is the row id. The icon uses the category-specific TypeA color. GUnknownByteIntMap0 maps TypeA to saved integer 1, which selects Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet at index one in battle.

TypeB.technical: CollectVoiceSamples precreates the TypeB bucket and appends matching sample ids. The tile requires an owned item whose VariableId is the row id. The icon uses the category-specific TypeB color. GUnknownByteIntMap0 maps TypeB to saved integer 2, which selects Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet at index two in battle.

Invalid.technical: Invalid is the 255 sentinel. GUnknownByteIntMap0 contains no entry for it, so CommitSettings dereferences an unsuccessful TMap Find when a selected row has this value. The sanitizer and restore paths use TMap operator[], which supplies zero for the missing key. No traced source caller assigns Invalid and no exported row uses it.

notes: CharacterCustomVoice rows pair IndexType with EGameCustomVoiceCategory. The saved values are per character and category, with First for normal attacks and Second for Cursed Energy attacks.
The saved integer is not the raw enum value. None and Default both map to zero, TypeA maps to one, and TypeB maps to two.
In battle that integer indexes CharacterSoundDataTable.Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet. Exported arrays place the low-HP PINCH set at index three, so index three is not a fourth custom-voice choice.
Every exported CharacterCustomVoice row uses Default, TypeA, or TypeB.
